  `table_data_source` varchar(100) CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_bin DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '技术字段，数据来源',
  `is_deleted` smallint NOT NULL COMMENT '逻辑删除标识，0未删除，1已删除',
  PRIMARY KEY (`pk_id`) USING BTREE,
  KEY `idx_dwd_industry_chain_info_industry_code` (`industry_code`) USING BTREE,
  KEY `idx_dwd_industry_chain_info_industry_name` (`industry_name`) USING BTREE,

  KEY `idx_dwd_industry_chain_info_level` (`level`) USING BTREE
